name: Pill button with masked letter roll-up label

label.note: Arrows are part of the label text (e.g. ' →'), not an icon.

stretch.note: At <=479 the button flexes to full width (xs:flex-auto xs:self-stretch).

variants.primary: bg ink #f5f6ff, text surface-1 #0b0b0b, padding 12px 20px (8px vertical <=767), 16/16 500; hover bg #00ffbf
variants.primary-small: bg ink, padding 8px 16px, 14.4/16, letter-spacing -0.36px; hover bg #00ffbf
variants.dark: bg surface-3 #1a1a1a, text ink, padding 12px 20px; hover bg ink, text surface-1
variants.dark-small: bg surface-3, padding 8px 16px, 14/16; hover bg ink, text surface-1
